newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB SETS 39-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB SETS 39-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR THURSDAY.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry will auction a five billion crown tranche of treasury bills on Thursday, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Wednesday.
The CNB said maximum yield in the Dutch-style auction was set at 11.80 percent, while net yield was set at 8.85 percent.
The Finance Ministry has not issued any T-bills with a similar maturity this year. As of January 1, T-bills are subject to a 25 percent witholding tax.
Gross yield in a March 15 auction of 52-week T-bills was 11.55 percent. The auction was heavily oversubscribed.
